queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    time_in_force,
    risk_margin_count,
    risk_margin_count * 1.0 / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT
  time_in_force,
  risk_margin_count,
  share,
  share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
FROM shares

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    timespan,
    risk_margin_count,
    1.0 * risk_margin_count / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT
  timespan,
  risk_margin_count,
  share,
  ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares

WITH time_in_force(timespan) AS (
  VALUES ('IOC'), ('GTC'), ('GTD'), ('FOK')
),
counts AS (
  SELECT t.timespan,
         COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM time_in_force AS t
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.timespan = t.timespan
  LEFT JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY t.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT timespan,
         risk_margin_count,
         CAST(risk_margin_count AS REAL)
           / NULLIF(SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT timespan,
       risk_margin_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
FROM shares
